name: Mac & Cheese with Aged White Cheddar & Gruyere
whyItWorks: White elbow macaroni or cavatappi in a smooth roux sauce made with lactose-free milk and naturally lactose-free aged cheddar and Gruyere.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with crushed Ritz crackers and broil in the toaster oven for 2 minutes until crisp.
